LanguageData.CC_PostPg_Rules: A people at peace with the colony and on good terms with it (goodwill 40 or more, or allied), who have traded with it three times or more lately and whose towns are far off (15 tiles or more), may open a trading post a few days from a home: a town of theirs that trades like any other.

LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TradingPosts: Friends who trade with a far colony may open a trading post a few days off, and close it if relations sour.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TradingPosts_Tip: A people at peace with the colony, with goodwill 40 or more (or allied), who have traded with it three times or more in the last 120 days, whose nearest town is 15 tiles or more away and who keep town traders (the Empire too), may open a trading post near a home. Each home is looked at every 15 days, with a 20% chance when a people qualifies: two posts a home at most, one per people, none within 60 days of another opening or closing there. The post stands 6 to 12 tiles from the home, toward their nearest town where it can, on a road or river by preference, never within 6 tiles of a colony. It is their town in every way: it trades, can be visited and attacked. While it stands their trader caravans come half again as often and the bandit road is twice as likely (with Systems talk to each other). Goodwill under 0 for ten days brings its keeper's warning, and ten more days close it, leaving a ruin; war closes it within a day. Raiders of a people at war with them may sack it. Off: no new post opens, and those standing are left as ordinary towns.
